The Handbook of Empirical Literary Studies is out!

Tags: IGEL

Moniek Kuijpers @moniek.kuijpers #1 2021-10-19 17:01 UTC

Dear all,

We, at IGEL, are proud to announce that our Handbook for Empirical Literary Studies is out. Each of our currently 21 research coalitions have written an overview chapter on their research area within the field of Empirical Literary Studies. The book is meant as an introduction for students or early career researchers into this rich - methodologically and theoretically - and ever expanding field.

You can find more information on where to buy it or how to download it here:

De Gruyter

Handbook of Empirical Literary Studies

We thank Don Kuiken and Arthur Jacobs for their hard work in putting this impressive collection of essays together.
